abstract: The presence of eosinophilic, hyaline globules in association with epithelial hyperplasia was noted in the rete testis of three patients with germ cell tumors. In the more florid examples, this proliferation formed a solid and microcystic pattern that, in association with the hyaline globules, mimicked a yolk sac tumor component. However, the bland cytologic features of the cells and the conformation to the configuration of the rete testis were keys to its reactive nature. A subsequent review of 48 testicular specimens containing well-defined areas of the rete testis showed hyaline globule formation in the rete testis or tubuli recti in 16 of 27 germ cell tumors, one of five other testicular tumors (four stromal tumors and one plasmacytoma), and none of 16 nonneoplastic cases. Many of the cases that had hyaline globules also showed epithelial hyperplasia. Further analysis demonstrated an incidence of rete testis invasion by neoplasm in cases that had hyaline globules, with or without epithelial hyperplasia, that was significantly higher (p less than 0.01) than that seen in neoplastic cases lacking hyaline globules. We concluded that this pseudoneoplastic reaction developed secondary to invasion of the rete testis by tumor. Immunostains supported the nonneoplastic nature of the proliferative lesions and indicated that the globules represented various proteins that had been absorbed from the lumen of the rete testis by the epithelial-lining cells but not successfully secreted.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を有する3例の患者の精巣網に、好酸性の硝子様小体を伴う上皮過形成が認められた。より顕著な症例では、この増殖は充実性および微小嚢胞性のパターンを形成し、硝子様小体と併せて卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分に類似した。しかし、細胞の異型に乏しいこと、および精巣網の形態に一致することが、反応性病変であることの鍵となった。その後、精巣網または直精管の明瞭な領域を含む精巣標本48例を再検討したところ、胚細胞腫瘍27例中16例、他の精巣腫瘍5例中1例(間質性腫瘍4例と形質細胞腫1例)で硝子様小体の形成を認め、非腫瘍性症例16例では認めなかった。小体を有する症例の多くは上皮過形成も伴っていた。さらに解析したところ、硝子様小体を伴う症例(上皮過形成の有無を問わず)では、小体を欠く腫瘍性症例に比べ、腫瘍による精巣網浸潤の頻度が有意に高かった(p<0.01)。われわれは、この偽腫瘍性反応が腫瘍による精巣網浸潤の二次的な変化として生じたと結論づけた。免疫染色は増殖性病変が非腫瘍性であることを支持し、小体は精巣網の管腔から上皮裏打ち細胞に吸収されたものの、分泌されなかった各種蛋白であることを示した。
